Ana V: Quick alert  restore jobs hitting KMS Decrypt AccessDenied for a small set of archived object snapshots (3/120). Not a full outage but worth triage.
Marcus: saw the errors around 2026-03-10T21:02Z. Sample: "NotAuthorizedException: kms:Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:iam::444555666:role/snap-restorer-new on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444555666:key/arch-cmk-9"
Priyanka: did we change any role names or the restore pipeline headers recently? We rolled the role rename last week and also tweaked S3 metadata keys in the restore agent.
Ana V: yes both. We renamed snap-restorer -> snap-restorer-new and changed the metadata key in the upload pipeline from "snapshot_id" to "x-snap-id" to standardize headers. Older snapshots still have snapshot_id in the EncryptionContext.
encops-bot: Detected 3 decrypt failures tied to arch-cmk-9 between 2026-03-10T21:00:01Z and 2026-03-10T21:05:12Z. Recommended steps: list-grants, map grantees to IAM, and create scoped grants preserving EncryptionContextSubset where required. Also flag encryptionContext key mismatch.
Marcus: list-grants shows grants referencing old role ARN arn:aws:iam::444555666:role/snap-restorer and constraints using {"snapshot_id":"snap-202311-12"}. Our current restore agent supplies EncryptionContext with key x-snap-id, so even re-granting with the same constraint would fail unless we match keys.
Priyanka: mitigation: create temporary CreateGrant entries for snap-restorer-new but use EncryptionContextSubset keyed to x-snap-id for the affected snapshots, then replay restores. Also record CreateGrant CloudTrail ids and retire grants after.
Ana V: agree. Short-lived grants only. We should not change key policy broadly. Also add a ticket and retention of CloudTrail events for audit.
Marcus: ran create-grant for the three snapshots with constraints using x-snap-id and returned GrantIds g-temp-210..g-temp-212. Replays succeeded for all three.
sec-oncall: compliance ok if grants are scoped, retired promptly (set retire-on timestamp), and the operator logs are attached to the incident ticket. Please call retire-grant when done.
Priyanka: follow-ups: 1) update RBAC rename checklist to sweep kms_grants for grantee ARNs, 2) add a preflight hook to fail renames if matching grants exist, 3) add a nightly detector job to surface grants whose grantee principal no longer exists or whose constraints use deprecated metadata keys, 4) add a one-line compatibility shim to the restore agent to accept both snapshot_id and x-snap-id.
Ana V: I'll open INC-2026-331, attach GrantIds and CloudTrail events, and update the rename runbook. Monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
encops-bot: Suggested pseudo-query for detector: SELECT GrantId, GranteePrincipal, Constraints FROM kms_grants WHERE GranteePrincipal NOT IN (SELECT arn FROM iam_entities) OR Constraints LIKE '%snapshot_id%';
